card.title: Public Respect
card.instruction: Seek visible signs of respect and treat private appreciation as insufficient.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Could you introduce me as Chair at the committee picnic?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I thanked you for chairing when you arrived.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Very warmly. Unfortunately, everyone else was unpacking.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll ask you to pass the sandwiches. They'll hear your name.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Say, 'Our Chair will now serve lunch.' Then I'll wait for them to look up.
